seoTitle: Writing Sprint Log: Words per Minute for Timed Sprints
metaDescription: Log timed writing sprints and see words per minute for each, your best sprint, average pace and how many sprints reach a daily target.
intro: Log your timed writing sprints (minutes and words) and see words per minute for each, your best sprint and a pace for a daily target.
why:
Timed sprints make a writing session measurable. Seeing words per minute shows which conditions work for you.

Enter one line per sprint: minutes and words, with an optional note. The tool shows pace for each sprint, the average and best, and how many more sprints of your chosen length reach a daily target at your average pace. For the timer itself use the Pomodoro Timer on this site.
howTo: Write one line per sprint, for example: 25 480 chapter 3.
Set your target for the day and sprint length.
Read the table and the pace.
